description: Groups individual Arcade missions into selectable roots, with one mission list per difficulty and a root title.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_ArcadeMissionSet. It comes from CharacterArcade->Id_ArcadeMissionSet on the root-select screen and from Game->ArcadeRun.RootSelection.RootId during an Arcade run, then is looked up over ArcadeMissionSetDataTables (DTM+0x970). No consumer reads the member as a value.

Id_ArcadeMission_Easy.simple: Ordered mission ids used for the Easy difficulty and as the fallback list.
Id_ArcadeMission_Easy.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. BattleArcade_GetMissionIds copies this array when Difficulty is neither Normal nor Hard; that includes Easy and any unrecognised difficulty byte. The resulting ordered ids drive mission panels, the run's MissionId, and the situation-overview progression.

Id_ArcadeMission_Normal.simple: Ordered mission ids used for the Normal difficulty.
Id_ArcadeMission_Normal.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. BattleArcade_GetMissionIds copies this array only when the difficulty byte equals EGameArcadeDifficulty::Normal; otherwise Easy or Hard is selected. Array order is preserved and the current stage is indexed by the number of already stored battle results.

Id_ArcadeMission_Hard.simple: Ordered mission ids used for the Hard difficulty.
Id_ArcadeMission_Hard.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. BattleArcade_GetMissionIds copies this array only when the difficulty byte equals EGameArcadeDifficulty::Hard. The returned ids are later resolved against ArcadeMissionDataTable; unused exported slots are None.

Id_Text_Title.simple: Localization text id for the root's displayed title.
Id_Text_Title.technical: FName, default None. UGameArcadeRootSelectListItemWidget::SetItemData passes it directly to RootNameText->SetTextIdOnly. The exported values are SYS_ARCADE_ROOT_SELECT_ROOT_LABEL_* text ids; the data table supplies only the id, not the localized string. Exported direct consumer is the list-item widget reached through UGameArcadeRootSelectWidget::Setup.

notes: The exported asset has 6 rows; each row supplies parallel Easy/Normal/Hard mission-id lists and a title text id. The manager loads ArcadeMissionSetDataTable into ArcadeMissionSetDataTables (DTM+0x970).
Difficulty is stored as a byte on the Arcade run and compared against EGameArcadeDifficulty; the default branch means Easy is also the safe fallback in the reconstructed receiver.
The mission-set finder 0x12fc180 is labelled behavioural in status/functions.json; source comments cite retail RVAs but this file does not claim byte parity.
No localization-variant or numbered-shard export exists for this table in the supplied set; only the supplied exported asset and reconstructed C++ were examined.

usages.detail: BattleArcade_GetMissionIds selects one of the three difficulty arrays from this row.
Attaches the resolved mission-set row to each root-select list item.
Displays Id_Text_Title through the root-name text widget.
Looks up the active root's mission set; the result is discarded by this consumer.
